top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is a distinct, mature invention: magic-wavelength Lamb-Dicke trapping of many neutral atoms decouples statistical power from accuracy, a concept absent from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-system prizes, and clock-to-clock agreement across independent laboratories at the 1e-18 level is direct verification. Katori (concept and first realization) and Ye (record accuracy and stability) are separable contributions, and a citation naming invention and realization keeps the scope tight. B038 is the deeper concept but has an incomplete credit chain (HgTe proposal, 3D topological insulators) and follows the 2016 prize; B042 is younger, with unsettled mechanism and co-first-author credit outside the three names. An award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to Katori and Ye, to Kane, Mele and Molenkamp, or to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero and Bistritzer
